Never fails for one bot: each result says REQUESTED (the new request), ALREADY_OPEN (the request waiting or running) or SKIPPED with a reason: NOT_ACTIVE (frozen), NO_TRADER (no claude-trader service asked for the bot's requests in the last 5 minutes, so nothing would pick one up) or RATE_LIMITED (20 per bot in 24 hours). dryRun: the order tools are blocked for every one of them. The caller must be ACTIVE: PLAYER_FROZEN or PLAYER_DISABLED refuse the whole call.
